root_cause.text: The `__rlookup_amd_iommu()` function in the AMD IOMMU driver accesses the `rlookup_table` array using the device ID without validating it against the maximum valid ID (`last_bdf`), allowing out-of-bounds memory reads for devices not described in the IVRS.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces a bounds check `if (devid > pci_seg->last_bdf)` before accessing `pci_seg->rlookup_table[devid]`, and the CVE description explains that the previous lack of validation caused out-of-bounds reads into adjacent slab contents which were dereferenced as pointers.
